title: 'Drunk' Comedian Goes FULL Karen at Nashville Airport
description:
A Scottish comedian & actress was caught on body cameras in the midst of a meltdown at the Nashville Airport. Police took Rachel Jackson, 35, into custody after she was seen acting bizarre, demanding water and a place to smoke. Despite the officers' attempt to let her go, the actress was denied boarding and escorted out of the airport when things quickly escalated. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
